title: JJK Shibuya Incident
description: The pivotal Shibuya arc — Halloween night!

questions.question: On what date does the Shibuya Incident take place?
questions.explanation: The Shibuya Incident occurs on Halloween night, October 31.

questions.question: Who seals Gojo in the Prison Realm?
questions.explanation: Kenjaku, posing as Geto, uses civilian leverage to seal Gojo in the Prison Realm.

questions.question: Toji Fushiguro is briefly resurrected during the Shibuya Incident.
questions.explanation: Granny Ogami's grandson summons Toji's soul, but Toji's consciousness takes over and kills himself again.

questions.question: Which Hashira-equivalent grade 1 sorcerer dies during Shibuya?
questions.explanation: Nanami is killed by Mahito after being burned by Jogo during the chaos.

questions.question: Sukuna unleashes Malevolent Shrine in Shibuya, leveling several wards.
questions.explanation: Sukuna's Malevolent Shrine open-domain devastates a massive chunk of Shibuya.

questions.question: Who finally exorcises Mahito?
questions.explanation: Just as Yuji is about to kill Mahito, Kenjaku absorbs him into his cursed spirit collection.

questions.question: Which character loses an arm fighting Mahito?
questions.explanation: Todo loses his arm fighting Mahito alongside Yuji.

questions.question: Choso fights Yuji before realizing they share a bond as brothers.
questions.explanation: Choso senses the blood bond with Yuji mid-fight and switches sides to help him.

questions.question: What is the rough civilian death toll of the Shibuya Incident?
questions.explanation: Roughly 30,000+ civilians die as a result of the curses and Sukuna's rampage.

questions.question: Who survives Sukuna's Malevolent Shrine using Reverse Cursed Technique?
questions.explanation: Choso uses RCT and his Blood Manipulation to survive Sukuna's domain.
